notes.title: Post-War Dreams Update : New Alpha Soon.
notes.content:
So much work is under the hood with Post-War Dreams lately. I managed to revamp the whole levels, missions, new save system in the last 2 months. I'll post a totally new version of the demo very soon.

In the meantime, please enjoy this new chapter, visual style still needs tweaking, I'm aware. Hopefully, you'll feel the spirit of the whole game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679634/d6f1b7a548ecb1a31ce00bedb0a127c002191911.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Update : Bunker Level
notes.content:
The bunker level is going under total revamp, as well as the whole game getting a total make-over for a new, darker and more gritty style.

Here's a w.i.p screenshot for the new bunker level.

There are tons other new changes, I'll post them later on with new game-play videos.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679634/d9e29e1162b4bef3f31d981a6c816ba8210ebeb0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Update : In-Game Journal
notes.content:
This new update is smallish but important : 

Total revamp of in-game menus, UI and Hud continues. Here's the latest version of in-game journal... Good thing is full game-pad support is added as well...

Soon, I'll mention about lots of other changes and improvements under the hood...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679634/cc517e3bba604a00efe3f30e178c416fcccd3097.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Update
notes.content:
Hello;
Just to remind everyone that I'm still working on Post-War Dreams as a solo-developer, although progress is slow but it is steady. Below is a screen from in-game dialogues, a new visual style has been set to mimic the comic-book look.

Lots of other changes and improvements to the game is under the hood, big announcement is coming soon as well as the totally new version of the pre-alpha demo...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679634/0b6e97d45095e246cbeef2d7ca529d445cf95291.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Story Update : Version 0.477
notes.content:
While we're digesting and embracing all sorts of feedback regarding Post-War Dreams's pre-alpha demo, our writer Wes Loch has finished the whole first draft of the story. And it is mere 32.327 words. Perhaps it is too much for an 2.5 side-scrolling action game, perhaps not. What we know for sure is that the whole premise is full of interesting characters, plot-twists and wonderful dialogues that spans different layers of emotion, especially for an post-apocalyptic setting.

We'll keep you updated and meanwhile enjoy one character portrait, posted below:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679634/af20f669970c7300cbb3b53c9ba8d08eb287a875.png[/img]

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Demo Update : Version 0.469
notes.content:
Hello everyone;
We have updated the pre-alpha demo of Post-War Dreams based on player feedback. Please feel free to send us more bug reports.

Here's the recent changes;

* Fixed idle state animations.
* Added more tutorial text.
* Fixed collision errors in various parts of the level.
* Fixed floating player error in some cases.
* Pistol now has more accuracy and better aiming.
* Updated the tutorial for frontal cover.
* Fixed wrong camera angles happening in certain re-loading check points.
* Re-made the fire animations in main menu.
* Fixed floating text in smaller resolutions.

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Update V.02
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679634/b8103082b82b320c8268e5cddc8e682ddfdb6147.gif[/img]

We are happy that our Pre-Alpha build, version V.02 is ready for internal testing and contains four chapters.

Our writer Wes Locher is very busy adding new content and the whole PWD texts are over 50.000 words already. Maybe that's too much of words but we want to present a rich, background world and lore, not just side-scrolling action.

Stay tuned!
